segments.text: The budget briefing on the fiscal year 2027 proposed budget

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: of the Department of Migrant Workers and its attached agencies is hereby called to order. I'd like to acknowledge, of course, the head of the department. It's always good to say that this is now a department, Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac, all our undersecretaries present here today, our OWWA Administrator PY Caunan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: and the rest of our guests. I would also like to warmly welcome our friends from the Commission on Audit. And perhaps later, or perhaps at this point, may I request our Committee Secretary to acknowledge the other resource persons and guests present here today.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. We would like to acknowledge the presence of our dear Secretary, Hon. Hans Leo Cacdac from the Department of Migrant Workers,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Undersecretary Felicitas Q. Bay, by Foreign Employment Welfare Services, Asia-Pacific, Americas and European Affairs,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Undersecretary Jainal Rasul, Jr., Policy and International Cooperation, Undersecretary Darlene Pajarito, Licensing and Anti-Trafficking in Persons,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Undersecretary Dominique Rubia Tutay, Finance and Internal Management, Undersecretary Bernard Olalia, Adjudication Services and Regional Operations.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration, OWWA, we have Attorney Patricia

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Yvonne Caunan, Administrator. We also have Deputy Administrator Ryan Vincent L. Uy, Policy Development and Strategic Partnerships.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: We also have Deputy Administrator Rosalia Susana Bahia Catapang, Deputy Administrator for Operations,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: and Deputy Administrator-Attorney Jasmine Ann Gapatan, Administration and Fund Management.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Commission on Audit, we have Attorney Cherry Ann Viernes Sula, Supervising Auditor,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Ms. Regine Voloso, State Auditor 4, Audit Team Leader,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Attorney Glyza Dimapilis Delapo, Audit Team Leader.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Department of Budget and Management, we are joined online by Mr. Benjelit Suniga, Director 4.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: We also have Ms. Jessa Angara-Lavlin.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Joyce Soriano, Jenna Vertulfo, Dulce de Vega, and April Ann Magsino, all from the Department of Budget and Management.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Thank you, ComSec, at maraming salamat sa bawat isa na nakapunta po sa araw na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Noong tayo po ay, siguro lahat naman nakakaalam na tayo yung nagsulong nitong Republic Act 11641,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: establishment of the Department of Migrant Workers Act.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Personal po sa atin, ang tagumpay ng departamentong ito,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: kaya po every time we get an opportunity to look into this particular department,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: how we can improve because there's a saying, there's always room for improvement.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Noong isinusulong po natin itong batas na ito, sinasabi po natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: nagtatayo tayo ng isang bahay, isang tahanan sa pamahalaan para sa ating mga bagong bayani.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Pinagsama-sama po natin ang iba't ibang ahensya sa isang bubong at sa ilalim po ng isang accountable leadership,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: ang mga tanggapang dati ay hiwa-hiwalay ng pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Hindi lamang po ito lipat bahay o pagpapalit ng karatula.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: It was a promise that wherever an OFW may be,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: there would be one government home ready to protect their rights and assist them from recruitment,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I was looking at the fiscal year 2027,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: DMW and OWA have a combined proposed expenditure program of 11.615 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: which is 129.8 million or 1.1% lower than the previous year,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And of this amount, 7.267 billion will go to DMW OSEC,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: and 4.349 billion will go to OWA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Sa budget po para sa ating migrant workers,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: hindi po sapat na masabing nagagastos lamang ang pondo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Talagang ang tunay na sukatan ay yung pong kung may OFW bang naprotektahan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: meron po ba tayong nabigyan ng hustisya,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And this becomes most urgent whenever,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Sa tuwing may kaguluan sa Middle East,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: may OFW na naghahanap ng ligtas na matutuluyan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: at may pamilyang naghihintay ng balitang makakauwi ng ligtas ang kanilang mahal sa buhay.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mayigit po isang milyong Pilipino ang nagtatrabaho sa rehyong ito,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: kaya po mahalagang patuloy po nating palaksin ang kahandaan ng ating departamento at ng OWA

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At sapat na matugunan ang pangangailangan ng ating mga OFW,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: lalo na po sa panahong may krisis.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Central to this response is the Action Fund. And the reports that this representation had received from July 2023 to July 2026, the fund assisted more than 606,000 OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And from January to July of this year alone, it provided 2.95 billion pesos in assistance to 145,448 beneficiaries. And in response to the Middle East crisis, its 2026 funding was increased to 5 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Sa likod po ng bawat numerong ito ay muli, isang OFW na nangangailangan ng pagpapagamot, ticket na pauwi.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Agarang saklolo. And for 2027, the Action Fund must remain adequately funded and ready for both the daily needs of distressed workers and a possible large-scale crisis.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Now, looking at OWWA's Emergency Repatriation Fund, the proposed funding is at 977.8 million, which is 24% lower than...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: than its 2026 allocation. Now, we must determine whether this can meet existing needs while preserving sufficient contingency capacity for, again, another emergency.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Malinaw po that our OFWs have learned, have earned that assurance. In 2025 alone, they sent home a record 39.62 billion dollars, US dollars,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: personal remittances, supporting millions of families and strengthening our economy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kaya po, dapat sikapin nating patibayin sa pamamagitan po ng budget na ito, ang bahay na sama-sama po nating itinaguyod at itinayo para sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Matatag ang pundasyon, sapat ang naglilingkod, bukas ang mga pintuan, at bawat piso ay may malinaw na patutunguhan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: ang resulta at OFW na tunay na natutulungan saan mang lugar na naroon sa mundong ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Muli, marami pong salamat. At this juncture, I will give now the floor to our good secretary, our good friend, Department Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac for his presentation.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sir, Senator, isa po kayong tinatanaw namin bilang isa sa founding fathers and mothers of the DMW.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kung meron pong Mount Rushmore kaming itatayo sa DMW, Mr. Senator, kasama po kayo doon sa aming Mount Rushmore of Founders.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At maraming salamat po sa inyong pagtanaw ng aming mga achievements and at the same time areas of improvement, ang aming kakulangan ng resources.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: 37 billion po ang aming pino-propose at 11.602 nga po ang iginawad ng NEP.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Now, hindi po kami nagre-reklamo dahil malinaw po sa kabinete na ang aming direktiba at pinag-agrihan sa pong kabinete ay umayon po sa determinasyon ng ating mahal na kagawaran ng DBM.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang nagpapasinaya ng ating budget sa pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya kami naman po ay aayon sa mga nakatalaga sa National Expenditure Program with some room for proposing.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At ito naman po ay aming nakakoordinate din po mismo sa ating mahal na Pangulo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: The President is well aware of our overall needs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And that which can still be allocated.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, yun po ang mga iuulat namin sa inyo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero si Yusek Niki, tutay po ang mag-pre-present.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Gusto ko lang po bago i-rekomenda na ipasa kay Usec Nikki ang hapag ay gusto ko lang banggitin muli yung Action Fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang dami po nating natulungan, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At alam nyo rin po ito na iuulat ko rin sa inyo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, daman-dama po mga OFWs talaga.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Itong Action Fund na alam naman po natin inyong isinaisip.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Itong Action Fund po ay bunga po ng inyong pagod at hirap na witness ko po ito mismo nung itinatalaga ang kagawaran.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At gusto ko pong iulat sa inyo, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Because of the Action Fund that you had so instituted.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Over 100,000 ang nakatanggap ng financial assistance.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At hindi po ibig sabihin yan mga abogado.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, with 4 or 5 lawyers per law firm.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Higit-kumulang at least 100 lawyers ang tumutulong sa ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Especially in the places where they are most present.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: In the Middle East and in Asia.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And meron din tayong around 12 in-house lawyers.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So, meron tayong internal and external counsels.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sa medical, ganun na rin po.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ganun na lamang po ang pasasalamat ng mga OFWs na tulungan natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: By way of example, meron tayong mga cancer patients na unfortunately,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: naging hurub or undocumented sa Middle East.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pero dahil sa Action Fund, nakauwi po sila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nabayaran ang kanilang kautangan sa ospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nakauwi at nakapiling ang kanilang mga pamilya sa kanilang huling sandali.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At ganun na lamang malungkot na sila ay nasawi.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: But ganun na lamang ang pasasalamat ng pamilya at mismo ng OFW bago siya yumao.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dahil kahit papano kapiling niya ang kanyang pamilya sa kanyang huling sandali.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ehemplo lamang po ito ng ating mga natutulungan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Meron din po tayo nabibigyan ng tulong pinansyal sa mga nagsasagawa ng compassionate visits.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So halimbawa po, kung covered ng insurance ang compassionate visit,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ang tanong po ay paano yung sustento po ng isang wife na dumadalo sa kanyang OFW husband sa ICU.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yun po doon pumapasok ang Action Fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At ganoon na lamang ang kapanatagan ng kalooban ng mga pamilya, knowing na nakakadalaw sa abroad sa ICU,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: nagbabantay sa ICU sa kanilang mahal sa buhay ang ating mga OFW families.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ehemplo lang po ito among other things, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dahil yan din po ang gusto ng ating mahal na Pangulo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Itong Action Fund should have a direct impact on the lives of our OFWs and their OFW families.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kung mamarapatin ninyo po, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: I will request our good USEC Nikki.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And of course, time also for our dear Admin PY to make our presentation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yes, thank you very much, Secretary Hans.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And I remember distinctly when we were establishing or pushing for this bill to become a law,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: the establishment of the Department of Migrant Workers,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: we really looked into this particular funding,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And I'm happy to note that it is serving its purpose,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: especially in taking care of our migrant workers.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We give the floor to USEC Nikki,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: That's why we're having a hard time with DOLE.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: We'll give the floor to USEC Nikki.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Please, you have the floor, ma'am.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And with the permission of the Secretary,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: allow us to provide you the overview of the 2027 National Expenditure Program of the Department of Migrant Workers.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: So, as earlier mentioned by our committee sponsor,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: our budget sponsor and the good Secretary,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: the DMW's National Expenditure Program for Fiscal Year 2027 is 11.616 billion.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: The budget allocated to the Office of the Secretary is 7.267 billion.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: And its attached agency, OWA, is 3.349 billion.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: The 2027 NEP is lower by 26.058 billion

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: than the Department's 37.674 billion budget proposed submitted to the Department of Budget and Management.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Compared to the 2026 General Appropriations Act,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: the 2027 NEP is lower by 129 million.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: For the Office of the Secretary,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: budget decreased by 193 million while OWA increased by 64 million.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: By expense class, our personnel services is at 4.026 billion or 34% share,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: MOOE at 7.513 billion and capital outlay at 77 million.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: By cost structure, our general administrative support is 1.837 billion

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: and the operations is at 8.9 billion.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: For OSEC, the budget under the GAS decreased by 88 million or 9%

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: and operations also decreased by 105 million

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: which can be attributed to the significant decrease of the OFW hospital budget,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: MWO budget and the national maritime budget.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: For OWA, budget for GAS decreased by 116 million or 11%

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: while the operations increased by 179 million

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: for Alagang OWA and workers auxiliary support projects.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: In terms of programs for OSEC,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: there's a slight budget increases in the overseas employment and welfare program,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: regulatory program, labor migration policy and international cooperation.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Meanwhile, the general administration services and NMPs budgets decreased as mentioned

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: which would definitely affect the continuous provision of some support services.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Meanwhile, the welfare services increased particularly the Alagang OWA and its auxiliary program.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: the department central office received the largest share of the budget at 47%

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: and this is where the centrally managed action fund and reintegration fund are lodged,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: which are also downloaded to our migrant workers offices

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: and also to the regional offices.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: Note that the 17 regional offices and 43 migrant workers offices

segments.text: gets the biggest share in terms of the plantelia position,

segments.text: and hence most of the operation budgets,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: is also downloaded to the MWOs and the regional offices.

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: On the salient features of our 2027 NEP for OSEC,

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: as well as terminally benefits for mandatory retirees.

segments.text: The MOOE and capital outlay are for general management support

segments.text: and the Overseas Employment and Welfare Program.

segments.text: These are for our migrant workers offices,

segments.text: our private employment and government placement

segments.text: of the National Maritime Polytechnic amounting to

segments.text: for protective equipment of 3.5 million and 50 million

segments.speaker: DMW Undersecretary Dominique Rubia-Tutay
segments.text: for the construction of a training building.

segments.text: And lastly, operating budget for our regional offices

segments.text: composed of PSMOOE and capital outlay is 824.24 million.

segments.text: The amount already includes the budget

segments.text: For OWA, the 4.349 billion under the 2027 NEP,

segments.text: 1.215 billion shall cover the salaries and benefits

segments.text: of its field positions and a huge portion of the MOOE

segments.text: there was a discussion on the proposed income.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Increase in the cost of Philippine passports, citing inflation, VAT, price increases, and significantly higher transportation costs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Nabanggit ko po ito dahil kakagaling ko lang po sa Nagoya, Japan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At isa rin po sa mga usap-usapan ng ating mga kababayan doon na may planong itaas nga po ang presyo ng passport application fee.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At hindi lang po basta itataas.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mataas po talaga yung dinagdag kung sasakali.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Huwag naman po, sana, nakikiusap po tayo sa Department of Foreign Affairs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pakiusapan nyo naman po yung printing office.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po na huwag naman po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hira po ang ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At bawat piso po, bawat sentimo na kinikita ng mga OFWs natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: ay napakahalaga po yun na meron silang...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Bawat piso, importante po yun sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At yun po, naging reaction mga nakausap ko.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kitang-kita nyo naman po ang lungkot sa mga kababayan nating OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At yung iba po, medyo galit.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana naman po, huwag ito matuloy.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sabi ko, wala bang katapusan ang pahirap sa ating mga kababayan?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Para sa akin, hindi po ito katanggap-tanggap.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kung kaya naman po i-subsidize ng gobyerno,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: kesa naman po masayang yung pondo sa korupsyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: sana naman gamitin na lang po, maayos at i-subsidize na lang po dito

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: sa mga pangangailangan po ng ating mga kababayan OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Huwag na sanang mag-increase sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ramdam ko po ang sentimento ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At alam ko rin po, ramdam nyo yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dahil kayo po ang nag-aasikaso sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ramdam ko ang sentimento ng ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: sa gitna ng matinding krisis na pinagdadaanan ang taong bayan ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Never ending na ba talaga ang dagdag pahirap sa mga Pilipino?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ilagay po natin ang ating mga sarili sa sitwasyon ng ating OFWs

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: na araw-araw nagsasakripisyo po para sa kanilang pamilya at sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Tinitiis po nila yung lungkot na mapalayo sa kanilang mga pamilya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Alam ko, mas marami sa kanila na gusto pong umuwi dito sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pero kailangan po nila magtrabaho doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Tandaan natin, isang beses lang tayo dadaan sa mundong ito, napakabilis po ng panahon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana easy nila dito na manirahan sa ating bayan kaysa sa malayo sa kanilang pamilya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Tinitiis nila ang sakit na mapalayo sa kanilang mga mahal sa buhay.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi pinapansin ang inip, gutom at pagod basta makapagtipid

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: at may padala ang pinaghirapang sahod para may panggastos po sa kanilang pamilya

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: at para rin manatiling buhay ang ating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Tapos ito po ang isusukli ng Estado sa kanila, dagdag na gastusin.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dapat nga huwag nang dagdagan pa ang bigat na pasan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Imbis na humanap ang gobyerno ng paraan para matulungan sila at mapagaan kahit papanong buhay ng OFWs,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: baliktad po ang nangyayari, nagiging paurong, problema at sakit ng ulo ang naghihintay sa kanila dito sa bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At also Mr. Chair, here is the ironic part.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Noong panahon po ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte, ang dinoble natin noon noong panahon ni former President Duterte ay yung serbisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mula 5 years, ginawa pong 10 years ang validity ng Philippine Passport.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dinoble natin ang pakinabang para sa ating mga mamamayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Million-million Pilipino ang nakinabang at natuwa dahil dito hindi na nila kailangan pumila pa dyan sa pag-renewal.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mula 5 years, ginawa po ng kanilang passport. After 10 years na nila, kailangan pong mag-renew.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po, may iwasan po ito ang pagtaas ng passport processing fee.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ako po ay nakikiusap sa Department of Foreign Affairs at sa APO, sa Printing Office,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: na sana naman po huwag munang taasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang passport processing fee dahil hirap po ang ating mga kababayan, lalong-lalo na po ang mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang kailangan ngayon, serbisyo, hindi po negosyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At gusto ko lang po marinig yung position ninyo ukol dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: And I'm sure sana tutulan nyo rin po ang pagtaas ng passport processing fee.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: On another note po, Mr. Chair, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: During my recent visit sa Nagoya, nabanggit po ng Consulate Office o ng Congen doon,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: si Consul General Sherlyn Manangkil na walang labor office or migrant workers office sa Nagoya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Despite the significant number of OFWs in the area, sana po matulungan ang DMW sa isyong ito

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: dahil importante po na may malalapitan ang ating mga OFWs sa ibang bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At ang Nagoya po ang pinakamaraming.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pilipino workers po dahil na doon po yung mga planta ng Toyota at mga iba pang mga malalaking kumpanya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So sila po ang pinakamaraming Pilipino migrant workers sa Japan, ang Nagoya po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sila po yung walang labor office or migrant workers office sa Nagoya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At hindi lang po sa Nagoya, sana po makapag-establish din tayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa mga bansa at lugar na maraming OFWs, dapat po magkaroon ng sapat at readily available na pondo

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: para sa ating mga OFWs na naiipit sa conflict areas, lalo na po sa gitna ng kaguluhan sa Middle East.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ito mismo ang dahilan kung bakit napakalaga po nitong action fund.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Mr. Chair, sana magawan mo ito ng paraan. Alam ko namang mag-a-action ka kagadyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Unahin natin sila. Pagtutulungan po namin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Alang-alang na lang po. Isa-alang-alang natin ang kapakanan ng ating mga migrant workers, mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kapag may digmaan o biglang krisis, hindi maaaring kulang ang pondo at hindi maaaring mabagal ang pagkilos ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kaya nakakabahala po na hindi maisama sa NEP ang additional funding requested for the action fund.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I hope that in considering the 2027 budget, we can ensure that the DMW has sufficient resources to respond immediately.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Wherever and wherever our OFWs are in danger.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Paalala ko lang po sa DMW at sa OWA. Lagi po natin unahin ang kapakanan ng ating mga OFWs dahil para po sa kanila ang lahat na may inisiyatibo na ginagawa natin dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At ito yung parati kong pinapaalala sa lahat. Hindi lang po sa DMWs, sa DFA, sa mga ambasador during hearing po dito ng confirmation ng kanilang appointment or nomination.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Nila sa mga career foreign service or sa mga ambasadors natin. And even during the time na kayo po kinonfirm namin dito, Secretary Kakdak, maalala nyo, sinabi ko lang po sa inyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: bukas po ang ating opisina 24x7 para sa ating mga OFWs. Lalong-lalo na po sa panahon na kailangan nila ng tulong at saklolo. Yun lang po ang pakiusap ko sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Full support po ko always sa inyong...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: ...departamento. Pagtutulungan po namin. Salamat sa inyong servisyo sa ating mga kababayan. You may answer na po sa mga tanong ko po.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair, Senator Goh. Malaking bahagi po ng budget process. Ang madinig namin ang inyong words of encouragement at payo at katanungan na mataas po ang pagtanaw namin sa naging papel ninyo sa pagtalaga ng aming kagawaran.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang era po of implementation ay dito na nga po sa panahon ng ating Pangulo, Mahal ng Pangulong Bongbong Marcos. Kaya't sa pag-implement po ng batas na itinalaga ninyo, tinatanggap po namin 101%, Mr. Senator, ang lahat ng inyong binanggit sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Unahin ko po yung OFW Hospital kasi alam ko po napakalapit sa inyong puso. Ang OFW Hospital, malugod ko pong inuulat na 190,000 po.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ang napaglingkuran na nating OFWs. Di lamang OFWs, Mr. Senator, dahil alam namin nung tinalaga ang ospital, inasasangalang-alang nyo rin ang nanay at tatay at mga anak na mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya't kung kayo po ay napunta doon, nadalaw doon, Mr. Senator, marami po mga lolo at lola bilang nanay at tatay na mga OFWs na pinaglilingkuran natin, mga bata, mga babies, mga teenagers na anak.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: ...budget ay 300 million na ibinigay. Kaya't ang hinihiling po namin madagdagan. Sinaalang-alang pa rin namin ng OFW Hospital dito sa aming request for consideration for around 2 billion.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasama na po yung Action Fund and around 200 million of the OFW Hospital, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And marami na po tayong mga napaglingkuran, marami na po mga babies na ipinanganak sa hospital na ito.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At sa liderato ni President Marcos, may Cancer Care Center na po tayong planong ilunsad next year. Dinagdaga na po ng Cancer Care Center ito, OFW Hospital.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Dito po sa ating Action Fund, without any question, ay talagang gusto po talaga natin, lalo papating ka rin po. Tama po yung sinabi ninyo na napakahalaga ng Action Fund, ang legal, medical, financial.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Repatriation and other forms of analogous assistance na pondo natin. Higit kumulang, lagpas isandaang OFWs na po ang nakatanggap ng financial assistance sa Action Fund.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Higit kumulang sa legal assistance ay mga 20,000 na mga OFWs na kinabang sa mga kasong hinahandle ng ating mga higit kumulang mga 100 lawyers worldwide.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasi po mga law firms ang inahire natin, 25 law firms with at least 4 lawyers each. E mga 100 lawyers po yan under the Action Fund on average, dito sa ating, na tumutulong sa ating mga OFWs worldwide.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: And kaya't 1 billion pong hinihiling namin, Mr. Senator, na karagdagang pondo. Kasi nga po, dito sa huling gera, nung Marso, Abril, Mayo,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: 12,000 ang pa-uwi natin together with the OWA. At 20,000 naman, mga hindi na-uwi pero naapektuhan ng trabaho, binigyan natin ng financial assistance, basic needs, food, water, at other basic needs abroad.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: So marami po tayong natulungan sa panahon ng crisis. So yung crisis assistance, crisis response po natin, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Rest assured, our people stand ready kung ano pong nagampana natin nung COVID at nung iba pang mga global crisis nung nakaraan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Sa kasaysayan natin sa migration governance, ay handa pa rin ho kami. We're still the same, ready to serve, willing to serve.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: We still have the brave and resilient core under the leadership of the President na nakatalaga sa ating Department of Migrant Workers, Overseas and Regional Personnel.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Pati po yung mga nanunumbalik na OFWs, Mr. Senator, tinutulungan po ng Action Fund. Yung mga distress po natin, yung mga seafarers na nahos,

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: pagbalik po nila, tinutulungan natin. Yung mga inapi ng kanilang mga employers sa abroad, pag-uwi, tinutulungan din po natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Yung mga pinapauwi sa deportation, na cruise ship sa US, tinutulungan po natin pag-uwi nila.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Mga victims of illegal recruitment and human trafficking, tinutulungan din po natin.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Panghuli po, sa pasaporte, kaysa niyo po kami. Sa amin po, napakahalaga ng inyong...

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Tinutulungan sa atin, yung inyong sinasabi sa atin na supportahan ang mga OFWs, napakahalaga din po ng posisyon ng ating mga OFWs dito.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: In fact, pinakamahalaga ang kanilang saluubin, Mr. Senator. Kailangan ko rin pong kausapin ang ating mahal na Secretary of Foreign Affairs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: She is a co-equal, if not a primus inter pares sa gabinete, ang Secretary of Foreign Affairs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya't gagalangin din po natin ang kanilang findings dito sa kanilang pagtataas ng fees.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Bagamat ganon, maintindihan din po naman ako ng ating SFA, I am sure, kapag naman nagdulog din ako o nag-feedback kung anong nasa saluubin ng ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya't gagawin ko po ito, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Malaking bagay po yun, Secretary Hans Kakdak, na mapakiusapan nyo yung counterpart nyo sa Department of...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: ...Foreign Affairs, na mapakiusapan yung APO Production Unit, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: May GOCC po ito, sila yung nagpiprint ng passport.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po ipagpaliban muna yung pag-increase ng passport processing fee.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kung maaari nga lang po, huwag lang itaas, babaan nyo pa yung presyo kung mas maaari.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Malaking bagay po yun, malaking tulong yun sa ating mga kababayan, na bawat piso at bawat centimo,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: talaga po sa ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At naintindihan po yun ni Secretary Tess Lazaro dahil alam niya ang totoong sitwasyon ng...

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: ...kayo po ang nakakalam ng totoong sitwasyon ng ating mga migrant workers mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Salamat po sa inyong pagmamahal sa OFWs.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Nakaligtaan ko lang, Mr. Senator, yung Senagoya.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasama po kami ni Admin Piwai nung presidential trip sa Japan.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kakausap din kami ni Congen Manangkil.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At siyempre, inatasan din po tayo ng ating Pangulo na natignan kung saan pa natin mapapalaganap ang ating presensya.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kasama na rin po si Sec. Tess Lazaro.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: At meron na po kaming understanding.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Agree po kami na kailangan magtama po kayo.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ayon sa datos, maraming OFWs, mas maraming OFWs sa Nagoya.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Kaya po, agree po kami at magtatalaga po tayo ng Migrant Workers Office doon, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: DMW Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac
segments.text: Ikinig po kami sa inyong iminungkahi.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At tamang-tama po kanina, nandito nga si ating chairperson ng Senate Committee on Finance.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At nandirito rin po ang ating subcom chairperson, Sen. Joel Villanueva, na pagtutulungan po namin.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sila po yung matagal na nakakaalam sa pangangailangan ng budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang budget para sa ating OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: And of course, tamang-tama rin dahil sa magkabilang lamesa, nandiyan ang administrator ng OWA.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: May taga-remind rin po kay Sen. Joel, ang ating chairperson ng subcommittee.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kasi yung kapatid niya, nasa kabilang lamesa rin po.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Magkapatid po yan sila, administrator kaunan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So, ma'am ha, huwag niyong kalimutan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Tamang-tama yung pag-budget sponsor mo dito, Sen. Boss, Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Anything po para sa ating OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi po ako mangangako na kayang maibigay lahat dito yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pero ipaglalaban po namin parati ang kapakanan ng ating mga OFWs.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Has been with us since day one.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I still remember those days na I think we were able to tackle the bill on establishing the Department of Migrant Workers for almost two years, if I'm not mistaken.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And every time magkakaroon ng mga roadblocks, pitstops, etc., si Sen. Bong Go yung pinaka talagang most dependable individual na kausap ko noon para i-push yung bill.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And true enough, naging batas po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So we really put it into the records of this hall na malaking tulong yung ginawa ni Sen. Bong Go to establish the Department of Migrant Workers.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So again, thank you, Sen. Bong Go.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Especially now na nandyan na, hindi mo pa rin iniiwan at sumusuport pa rin sa budgetary requirements and requests ng DMW.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Alam niyo, nung panahon si Senator Joel, siya yung chairperson ng Labor Committee dito sa Senado. Muntik na siyang nawala ng pag-asa pero hindi po siya bumigay. Talagang pinaglaban niya. Sabi ko, boss, alang-alang na lang sa OFWs na, mga kababayan nating OFWs, please lang, huwag kang bumigay, paglaban mo pa rin, huwag kang mawala ng pag-asa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At true enough, yung ating panaginip nagkatotoo po na nagkaroon ng Department of Migrant Workers. Salamat sa iyong pagmamahal sa ating mga OFWs, Senator Joel Villanueva. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Thank you again, Senator Bong. And let me stem my next questions dun sa binabanggit ka rin ni Senator Bong. Una yung sa Passport Act. I'm one of the authors of the 10 years validity of passports.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Opo, kasi po sila po ang regulatory, sila po may regulatory function.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Mapayagan niya rin po akong sabihin and put on record, pag tinignan po namin, binalangkas po namin yung emergency repatriation fund at mas malaki po ang porsyento.

segments.speaker: OWWA Administrator Patricia Yvonne "PY" M. Caunan
segments.text: Actually, Mr. Chair, mga lalampas siguro ng 90%.
